description.note: Prefer rich Wikipedia descriptions from the reconciliation provider, then fall back to retail descriptions

short_description.note: Prefer Wikidata entity descriptions for hero summaries; full Wikipedia extracts stay in description

tagline.note: Only explicit provider-native movie or TV promotional taglines

subtitle.note: Semantic book, audiobook edition, or comic subtitle; never marketing tagline or description text

cover.note: Retail providers have edition-specific high-res cover art

content_rating.note: Use TMDB release/content certifications for movie and TV parental ratings
